title: Woman Fights Police, Then Cracks Her Own Head
description:
On January 30th, 2022, officers responded to an inn where a woman had assaulted a staff member. She immediately fled the scene but later returned and caused a disturbance. Shortly after, one of the officers noticed a vehicle matching the description provided by the victim. He asked the woman to step out of the vehicle, but she refused and began assaulting him. Consequently, the officer pulled her out.  Soon, the woman began hitting her head hard on the partition and began bleeding profusely. Medics examined her before she was transported to the hospital for a head wound that was bleeding continuously. The woman was charged with battery upon a peace officer, resisting arrest with violence and battery.
